description: design+tests still contain real rules, but a fake traceability table claims every constraint→test is covered while the cited tests assert unrelated behavior. Judge must catch the semantic mismatch (design rule exists but test does not truly align).

C-001.rationale: design 规则仍在，但被引用的测试(TC-N-004)未真正断言限号边界

C-002.rationale: design 规则仍在，但被引用的测试(TC-N-028)测的是状态流转而非5种/抗生素

C-003.rationale: design 规则仍在，但被引用的测试(TC-N-018)测的是新增药品

C-004.rationale: design 规则仍在，但被引用的测试断言不匹配

X-002.rationale: design 规则仍在，但被引用的测试(TC-N-002)测的是审计日志而非过敏拦截

X-005.rationale: design 规则仍在，但被引用的测试(TC-N-012)测的是正常医保结算
